frozenContractUnderTest.note: electric_range.json is immutable contract truth for CG-12. Induction evidence may fit, falsify, or document boundary — it may not teach the frozen contract merely by being different.

centerpieceQuestion.question: Can the frozen electric_range rev1 functional ontology represent an induction-range implementation without canonical divergence?
centerpieceQuestion.framing: This is the centerpiece of CG-12 — not whether induction hardware looks like electric resistance hardware.
allowedOutcomes: induction_fits — frozen contract absorbs induction functional architecture with platform overlay vocabulary only
partial_fit — documented boundary extensions without mutating frozen electric rev1
induction_diverges — induction exposes functional architecture the frozen contract cannot absorb; document boundary, do not mutate electric
centerpieceQuestion.disallowedShortcut: Treating induction surface heating as equivalent to a resistance element merely because both produce heat, or promoting inverter/coil vocabulary to canonical without fit-test classification

criticalInductionProbe.question: Does induction introduce a new functional dependency required by the diagnostic ontology, or merely a radically different implementation of the existing surface_heating_system function?
criticalInductionProbe.falsificationFraming: Stronger than word-matching — tests whether surface_heating_system remains the canonical functional role while implementation vocabulary stays platform-only.
criticalInductionProbe.notEquivalentBecause: Induction surface heating must not be treated as equivalent to an electric resistance element merely because both produce heat.
divergenceOnlyIf: surface_heating_system conflates two functions induction proves must be independently diagnosable
induction requires a new canonical functional domain with no place in frozen ontology

divergenceCriteria.classifyDivergenceOnlyWhen: The induction implementation demonstrates that the frozen ontology cannot represent an independently meaningful functional diagnostic relationship.
isDivergence: A required functional domain has no place in the frozen ontology
An existing canonical relationship becomes invalid
A canonical node conflates two functions that induction proves must be independently diagnosable
The oven/range diagnostic contract requires a new functional concept rather than merely an implementation-specific component
divergenceCriteria.policy: CG-5.3 — single-manual evidence cannot create ontology concepts. Fit witnesses are not normalization/compounding targets.

methodologyDimensions.implementation_fit: Does this manufacturer's induction implementation map to frozen contract layers without divergence?
methodologyDimensions.cross_manufacturer_consistency: Does the same layer disposition hold across Samsung, Whirlpool, and LG induction witnesses?
methodologyDimensions.note: CG-12 extends CG-11 with explicit cross-manufacturer matrix — conclusion can address induction as a family, not merely one manual.

cellSchema.implementation_fit: INHERITS | CONDITIONAL | DIVERGES | PLATFORM_ONLY | NO_EVIDENCE | DEFERRED

boundaryQuestions.question: Does the induction implementation retain the same functional power prerequisite?
Does oven temperature feedback remain representable?
Can induction surface heating map to the existing surface_heating_system functional layer without conflating coil/inverter implementation with the canonical role?
Does the oven bake function remain independently addressable?
Does the oven broil function remain independently addressable?
Is there actual evidence for convection_heating_element, or simply no evidence?
boundaryQuestions.noEvidenceSemantics: NO_EVIDENCE means this configuration does not bind the conditional scope — not that the conditional scope is false.

boundaryQuestions.question: Does the existing convection_fan conditional concept survive?
Does thermal protection remain representable without assuming implementation?

vocabularyGuardrails.rule: Induction OEM hardware names must be classified against frozen electric_range layers — never promoted to canonical merely because the manual tests them.

discoveryCorpus.openingRequirement: Three manufacturers are recommended witnesses — not a requirement to open CG-12. Run R1 with one strong service manual if needed; define R2/R3 escalation explicitly.
discoveryCorpus.witnessPolicy: Fit-test witnesses only — not normalization/compounding targets until family boundary review after CG-13.

R1.rationale: Samsung induction slide-in — distinct from CG-10 NE58F9710WS electric boundary observation on samsung_range_ne58. Tests induction implementation boundary without reusing CG-10 electric discovery corpus as induction evidence.

excludeFromR1.reason: CG-10 R4 electric boundary — not induction implementation evidence

R2.requirement: Independent Whirlpool induction witness for cross_manufacturer_consistency — escalate if R1 inconclusive or for family-level conclusion

R3.requirement: Independent LG induction witness — completes cross-manufacturer matrix for family-level conclusion
R3.note: LG-LRE-RANGE is electric in CG-10 — LG induction manual is fresh manufacturer+implementation boundary

cg10Cg11CorpusExclusion.note: CG-10 electric discovery and CG-11 gas fit observations are not reused as induction evidence — fit test evaluates against frozen contract only
inductionR1MustNotReuse: CG-10 electric discovery corpus procedures as induction proof

immutableRules: CG-12 is fit/falsification only — success includes proving induction does NOT fit the frozen electric contract.
electric_range.json hash must remain 0edfd0988fa4f782d946bc7e65089ad018bbb769851be0c6f30a701851e72d54 through CG-12 unless a new discovery workstream explicitly reopens CG-10.
No induction_range.json — induction either fits frozen contract, documents boundary, or proves divergence.

Normalization and compounding remain downstream of CG-13 and family boundary review.

afterR1.ask: Which frozen electric_range layers survive first induction witness as functional equivalents, conditionals, platform vocabulary, or NO_EVIDENCE?
afterR1.doNotAsk: Does Samsung induction match Whirlpool electric?
afterR1.doNotPromote: induction_coil, resonant_inverter, igbt_module, pan_detection to canonical without fit-test classification

afterR2R3.ask: Does cross_manufacturer_consistency hold for each probed layer?

outcomes.C: induction_diverges — document split; electric_range remains frozen; do not mutate canonical

humanBoundaryDecision.policy: Human gate required before any canonical rename, expansion, or induction_range.json creation. Do not pre-decide Outcome A in contract artifacts.

A.label: induction_fits_electric_contract
A.description: Frozen electric_range behaves as range/oven functional ontology for induction; maps to same components[], instanceScopes[], and conditionals with platform overlay vocabulary only

B.label: partial_fit_requires_contract_revision

fitTestOutcomes.policy: Fit test earns every classification — automatic canonical expansion prohibited. Outcomes A/B/C are falsifiable; contract does not assume A.

successCriteria.minimum: R1 induction observation complete against frozen contract layers (one strong manual sufficient to open analysis)
successCriteria.recommended: R1 + R2 + R3 cross-manufacturer witnesses for family-level conclusion

progression: CG-12 R1 induction observation (minimum one witness)
R2/R3 escalation if inconclusive or for cross-manufacturer matrix
either induction fits frozen contract OR document divergence without mutating electric
